facts.text: Under SFA's Purple Promise program, qualifying Texas freshmen and transfer students with combined family adjusted gross income of $100,000 or less receive 100% coverage for tuition and mandatory fees for up to four years.

sources.title: Purple Promise | SFA
sources.quote: Incoming fall first-year and transfer students who qualify will have 100% of their tuition and mandatory fees2 covered for up to four years1 as long as they maintain their eligibility.

sources.title: Purple Promise | SFA
sources.quote: Your combined family adjusted gross income must be $100,000 or less, based on the information you enter on your FAFSA.
